publication_boundary: private geocoding evidence only; no release eligibility

operational_policy.key_source: GEOAPIFY_API_KEY from the process environment only
operational_policy.key_or_address_logging: never log or print keys, address queries, or raw provider responses
operational_policy.provider_processing: address query, client IP and request metadata are sent to Geoapify; its published DPA says detailed personal data are normally kept no longer than 24 hours, with exceptional retention up to two months
operational_policy.result_retention: stored results are allowed under Geoapify's open-data terms when required data-source attribution is retained
operational_policy.attribution: retain Geoapify and source-data attribution with private results; free-plan display requires Geoapify attribution/follow-link and OpenStreetMap attribution
operational_policy.publication_boundary: provider terms, source rights, privacy, attribution, and publication require separate review; this profile grants private processing only

match_policy.address_acceptance: building or amenity result; normalized provider address line exactly matches the first source address line; country matches
match_policy.locality_acceptance: city result; normalized locality exactly matches an explicitly supplied source city/locality; country matches
match_policy.confidence_disclosure: Geoapify rank confidence is provider metadata, not a calibrated probability or factual review
match_policy.precision_disclosure: address matches are address-level provider points; city matches are approximate locality points, not facility coordinates
match_policy.provenance: retain full provider result privately with source ID, source key, artifact hash, query, timestamp, confidence, result type and match method

profiles.source_scope: FSA England and Wales accepted source records only; AddressWithheld rows have no location evidence and are never queried
Food Standards Scotland accepted source records only; Scotland feed remains distinct
Only records explicitly marked eligible by the source lane; coordinate-bearing, withheld, unknown-scope and non-core records are excluded
Only explicitly eligible, privacy-screened source address evidence; this profile grants no public approval
Active APHIS registration rows with explicit mailing city and state only; city points are approximate mailing-locality references, never operating-site or facility coordinates
Only AESAN RGSEAA rows in source keys 10, 12, 14, or 15; retain industrial address privately and query through the existing bounded address-enrichment queue only after separate transfer authorization
Only current-snapshot BLtU business street-address candidates with locality; external query contains street, locality, and country only, never establishment name or source payload
